prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: lime green. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them. Every cutout is matte paper reflecting only the room light, with a plain blank face: coin rims, document faces, screens and vehicle sides carry no lettering, numerals or marks.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons, tape, rubber stamps, string and pins, stencilled arrows, paper bar charts, stacked sheets, grid paper, torn strips, hole-punched tags, paper clips, in cream, black, pale yellow or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture and print dots.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip: one line, no wider than a third of the frame width, with safe margins, the chip sitting clear of the subjects. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw. When the beat marks a hero number, that number alone may be printed larger, up to half the frame width.
8. Compositions vary in scale from beat to beat: some show one oversized subject filling the frame, some a small subject alone on open ground, some several elements arranged as a diagram.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: lime green.
Subjects: a hole-punched tag; a paper hand.
Opens on the stencilled arrow, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip is covered as the stencilled arrow rolls into a hole-punched tag; a paper hand enters and holds it still.
Ends holding on the held tag.
This composition is oversized: one subject fills most of the frame.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "SPECULATIVE".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "SPECULATIVE". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: No voice, no speech, no dialogue, no lyrics. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects only; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage in a 2D motion design style, photographed as a flat lay under soft, natural room light originating from the upper left. <Picture 1> serves as the initial frame, showing a lime green paper ground with a cream paper chip reading "BRAZIL $77B" and a black-and-white halftone map cutout with a cream stencilled arrow. Immediately upon the start of the video, the existing elements slide off-frame rapidly to the left, and a new composition begins. A cream paper chip with a rough torn edge lands firmly in the upper third of the frame, featuring the clean, bold, black sans-serif text "SPECULATIVE" printed legibly; this chip remains static and uncovered throughout the shot. In the lower two-thirds of the frame, a cream stencilled arrow, carried over from the previous sequence, rolls and transforms with a quick, snappy motion into a cream hole-punched tag. Simultaneously, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of an anonymous paper hand enters from the right with a slight overshoot, its fingers gripping and holding the hole-punched tag steady in the center of the frame. The hand and tag are oversized, filling most of the lime green ground. Every cutout, including the hand, features a rough, white torn-paper edge and casts a small, soft shadow to the bottom right. The camera remains in a Static Shot throughout the 5-second duration. By the final second, the hand and tag hold a steady position with a subtle, rhythmic loop of micro-movement.

overall_soundscape: The audio consists of tactile, physical foley sounds. A crisp, quick paper-slap occurs as the headline chip lands, followed by a sliding friction sound as elements move. A distinct, short adhesive tape peel and a soft paper rustle synchronize with the arrival and gripping action of the paper hand.
